Subject: Exec ask draft — MedAnalytics (DEAL-2026-1098)

Team — draft below for Mina's review. I recommend we approve a 30% unit-rate concession off Hosted API list for a 12-month committed consumption (minimum $1.0M committed spend), with the following constraints:

- Discount: 30% off list for text-generation token consumption only (embeddings and reranking at standard rates)
- Commitment: 12-month term, $1.0M minimum committed spend (prepaid quarterly or net-30 invoicing with a 2% fee)
- No private deployment or custom infra (hosted-only)
- Additional: 24/7 priority support during ramp + SLO targets in term sheet for throughput/latency
- Concession expiry: Offer valid for signature within 7 business days

Rationale: closing at 30% is aggressive but this account unlocks several health-system references and a likely move to Dedicated down the road. If we push only to 22–25% we risk losing the deal to ApexAI.

Attachments: Term sheet v3 (with placeholders for discount, commitment), forecast.

Mina — would you consider approving a one-time exec-sanction at 30% conditional on legal finalizing the term sheet guardrails? If not, a 22%–25% approval with firm $1.2M commit might be acceptable.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Exec ask draft — MedAnalytics (DEAL-2026-1098)

Ben / Steph — quick take from precedent and revenue ops:

- Past approvals at ~25% required stronger contractual protections (prepay or larger minimums). Approvals above 25% have been granted only when the deal included explicit enablement commitments and a documented migration path to Dedicated or an annual renewal guarantee.
- If we do 30% now, we should: require $1.2M minimum, net-45 payment with irrevocable fund hold (or prepay), and commit to a 12-month ramp checkpoint with opt-out only in cases of material breach.

I don't love 30% as an open playbook item — it sets a difficult precedent. I'm willing to recommend 22%–25% with the stronger financial protections noted. If Ben thinks 30% is necessary, we should get Mina's explicit exec signoff and capture a short-form mitigation checklist in the term sheet.

Marcus
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Exec ask draft — MedAnalytics (DEAL-2026-1098) — Exec sanction granted

Thanks all for the clear context. I reviewed the forecast and the commercial rationale. After weighing the strategic value and churn risk, I approve an executive-sanctioned unit discount of 25% off Hosted API list price for MedAnalytics, with these hard conditions: 

1) Commitment: $1.2M minimum committed consumption over 12 months (signed in the term sheet).
2) Payment: Prepaid quarterly (or a single prepayment) — we will not proceed on extended net-60 terms for this concession.
3) Hosting: Hosted-only (no Private/VPC or on-prem).
4) Observability: Customer must agree to deploy Redwood's Optimize+ monitoring suite and allow token-level usage reporting for the duration of the first 12 months.
5) Legal: Sales to work with Legal to insert a one-time concession clause (non-precedential) and automatic reversion to list pricing at renewal.
6) Signature window: Offer valid for 10 business days; after that the concession expires.

This lands us at the requested >20% threshold while protecting revenue and operational risk. Ben/Stephanie — please finalize the term sheet reflecting these conditions and send to Liam with the DocuSign link. Loop me on the signature email.

Mina Haddad
SVP, Sales Operations & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
